notes.title: Cosmonautics Day in the Oort Cloud!
notes.content:
On April 12, 1961, Yuri Gagarin became the first human to travel into space, blazing a trail for the Astro Lords centuries later.

We're celebrating this momentous day by offering:

- All Bronze, Silver and Gold runes can be bought for credits
- 50% off the update cost for the Improvements section of the Store
- 25% discount on premium ships
- 25% discount on artifacts

[i]These promotions will expire at midnight (game time) on April 13.[/i]

Enjoy Cosmonautics Day and go forth to explore the Oort Cloud!

notes.title: Latest News from the Oort Cloud: 21-27 March
notes.content:
- The most profitable tritium alien battle was Aliens 47, where players earned 96 tritium.

- A fatal error made by a member of the Blue Team led to defeat in battle.

- True assassins don't need to see enemies on the battlefield - they sense them! Watch "Assassins" to see real skill in action.

- Lord Lutuy not only survived against a triple Tritium Boss challenge, but he also caused the most damage, earning 663 tritium. 

- Only one error separated victory from defeat in "Spectacular Reaper".

[i](Enter the game and check the Galactic News for replays of these events.)[/i]

notes.title: Deuterium Price Drop!
notes.content:
Good news for deuterium fans! The prices and package sizes in the deuterium store have been reviewed, and some packages have [b]dropped in price as much as 35%[/b].

The new packages and prices are:

375 deuterium - $4.99
800 deuterium - $9.99
1,700 deuterium - $19.99
4,500 deuterium - $49.99
10,000 deuterium - $99.99
55,000 deuterium - $499.99

Deuterium can be used for special ammo, training your Captains, purchasing more powerful asteroids and ships, and much more. As well as acquiring deuterium in the store, you can also earn deuterium for completing quests from your advisors. 

[i]If you've got any questions about deuterium, contact support@bisbog.com[/i]

notes.title: Second Astro Lottery Winners Announced!
notes.content:
The draw for the second Astro Lottery has taken place. 899 tickets were entered into the draw, and the three lucky winning numbers are:

2040319
4181217
9237149

Congratulations to the winners, who each receive 114,983 deuterium from the prize fund! 

The draw was made using the random.org video lottery system. You can view the draw on the Astro Lords YouTube channel. 

All participants in the Astro Lottery have received 50 deuterium for every card they activated. 

Thanks for taking part in the Astro Lottery!

notes.title: Latest News from the Oort Cloud: 1-7 February
notes.content:
- There's less than a week left to grab your ticket for the second Astro Lottery! The prize fund is growing every day, so don't miss out on your chance to win. Good luck!

- In the Reaper battle mode, Lords Fermer and Duke fought to a stalemate.

- The most profitable tritium alien battle was Aliens 55, where players earned 138 tritium.

- Lord SteelNuts was able to earn an impressive 392 tritium by destroying a powerful Tritium Boss. Congratulations!

[i](Enter the game and check the Galactic News for replays of these events.)[/i]

notes.title: Connection Issues Under Investigation
notes.content:
Many players are currently reporting issues when trying to connect to Astro Lords: Oort Cloud via Steam. 

We have informed the developers about this issue, and they are investigating. 

As soon as we have received more information from the developers, we will share the details with you. 

We apologise for the inconvenience and we aim to restore normal game access as swiftly as possible. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Latest News from the Oort Cloud: 18-24 January
notes.content:
- There are only a few weeks left in the second Astro Lottery! Don't miss your chance to win one of three prizes, ranging from 100,000 to 1,000,000 deuterium! The more tickets you have, the greater your chance of winning.

- The most profitable tritium alien battle was Aliens 60, with players earning 131 tritium.

- Despite Cybstalk's Starbase having a strength of 365,000 they were unable to fend off a powerful attack from robbers, with the Starbase falling in the final seconds of the battle.

- In "Bloodless Block 35", Petrovich forgot the rules of engagement and paid a penalty of more than 1,000,000 credits. Ouch.

- And in the intense struggle of "PVP Survival of Deuterium 40", blue team players were able to smash through the enemy defenses and acquire nearly 600 deuterium.

- Lastly, congratulations to Casusbelli who activated a Tritium Boss card and won the battle, earning 1,146 tritium.

[i](Enter the game and check the Galactic News for replays of these events.)[/i]
